caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate mug placed centrally on the page, shown in profile with the handle on the right side. The mug is wide at the base, curves inward near the middle, and flares out again toward the lip. There is an intricately decorated band, possibly featuring floral or leafy motifs, running vertically along the visible side of the mug. The handle has a curved and slightly elaborate design. The coloring is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black, giving a metallic appearance, with some brownish stains and discolorations on the background paper. To the right of the mug, there is a detailed illustration of an armorial crest featuring a shield, a helmet, arrows, and decorative foliage. Beneath this, the text "MUG" is printed, followed by "T8799-15," "APPR. 3rd Stall," "CASE No. 1," with "HEADER" faintly inscribed at the bottom. The overall composition is a drawing and sketch in pencil with some possibly inked elements, on an aged and slightly stained piece of paper.
title: Silver Mug
